known_upper_equipment_masks.admission: observed source-connected mask, independent of temporal MAD

cleanup.equipment_proxy: known upper observed mask OR all-frame dark temporal residual outside dense person masks; diagnostic, not semantic camera/staff GT

limitations: Equipment proxy is temporal/color evidence, not semantic camera or staff ground truth.
Reflections, wires and small color residuals are diagnostic and do not abort the full run.
Registration round-trip interpolation can soften cleaned pixels.
